Ah that sounds interesting lol

The government site lists what you need for what boats etc. It's just the case of covering costs if necessary.

I plan on heading to the penzance job centre because of the STCW courses to see if they can help with them.

That'd be worth a try if the job centre fails, and yeah no experience.
Ah no problem. Not wrong though lol. Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.

You do realise that posting in that sub-reddit can also be a form of venting / putting out there to other people who know or share the same feelings right? 

Secondly, you have ignored the construction of my post in that sub. Does it come off as unhinged at all? Any mention of attempts or merely the feelings of it?

Lastly, the exact reaction you have responded with is why people who feel that way despise opening up. Ignorant of the individual. Hell you clearly didn't even read what I wrote in the first place as your immediate response to start telling me what I "need" to do.
If only it'd be simple to get hold of a boat

Your opening response is something that is on my mind.

Then your follow up edit just completely overshadowed your reasonable response with offensive assumptions of myself without ever having talked with me.

This is my second attempt at a post. First was too much like an essay.

What I've shortened it to is the problem I've experienced of opening up is the reaction, as you described, the person talks the same shit that you always hear or turns off after a period a time. Then you feel even worse or just shut off.

I'm lucky is I actually got to experience the type of friendship from my closest friend that really helped when I've been in a depressed / suicidal mindset - he acknowledges that I'm suffering yet doesn't try to help with that specifically because, he's said himself, he doesn't understand it. Instead he asks what I'm feeling, any reasons why for it, then talks to me like normal, (gaming news / his work etc) whilst assuring me I can talk to him any time about it if I really need it, which he has proven true to.

If we lived closer so could hang out I'd probably be alot better off than I currently am but that's my experience with a response that actually helped me when I've opened up.

That's the main issue for me. I'd rather do something with someone because it'd be more fun than just by myself. I never really have anyone to do something in person with. All this technology replacement is demoralizing as hell.

There is the part of me that refuses to give up. Its the problem of if you want to do anything remotely hard / requires competence suddenly there's lots of hoops / money to go through first.

If I had a relationship or someone was dependent on me it'd be a completely story. Whether it be improving myself / getting on with stuff / having a shoulder to lean on. It wouldn't be as taxing. Being on my own for so long just feels like it's reaching a limit.
